ds2.4.1:3.2: catūsu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyāvyākataṃ, rūpañca nibbānañca,
ds2.4.1:4.2: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ca kiriyato ca pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:5.2: dve domanassasahagatā cittuppādā, dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ etthuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:6.2: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro arūpāvacarā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca, etthuppannaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:6.5: ime dhammā na vattabbā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttātipi.
ds2.4.1:9.2: tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyāvyākataṃ rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:10.2: tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, yaṃ ca rūpaṃ kammassa katattā,
ds2.4.1:11.2: tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyāvyākataṃ, yaṃ ca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā,
ds2.4.1:12.2: cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:14.2: tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyāvyākataṃ, sabbaṃ ca rūpaṃ,
ds2.4.1:15.2: cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:16.2: kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato ekādasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato dve, kiriyato ekādasa, rūpāvacaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca etthuppanne vitakkavicāre ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:17.2: rūpāvacarapañcakanaye dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttarapañcakanaye dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca etthuppannaṃ vicāraṃ ṭhapetvā, vitakko ca,
ds2.4.1:18.2: dve pañcaviññāṇāni, rūpāvacaratikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikajjhānā kusaloto ca vipākato ca, pañcakanaye dutiyajjhāne uppanno ca vicāro, rūpañca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:18.4: vitakkasahajāto vicāro na vattabbo savitakkasavicārotipi, avitakkavicāramattotipi, avitakkaavicārotipi.
ds2.4.1:19.2: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato pañca, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaradukatikajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca etthuppannaṃ pītiṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:20.2: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro somanassasahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cattāro, kāmāvacara kusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato pañca, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca etthuppannaṃ sukhaṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:21.2: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro upekkhāsahagatacittuppādā, akusalato cha, kāmāvacarassa kusalassa vipākato dasa, akusalassa vipākato cha, kiriyato cha, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, lokuttaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca vipākato ca etthuppannaṃ upekkhaṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:21.4: pīti na pītisahagatā, sukhasahagatā na upekkhā sahagatā,
ds2.4.1:21.5: sukhaṃ na sukhasahagataṃ siyā pītisahagataṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ, siyā na vattabbaṃ pītisahagatanti.
ds2.4.1:21.6: dve domanassasahagatacittuppādā dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ, yā ca vedanā upekkhā, rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:21.7: ime dhammā na vattabbā pītisahagatātipi, sukhasahagatātipi, upekkhāsahagatātipi.
ds2.4.1:23.5: ime dhammā siyā dassanena pahātabbā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
ds2.4.1:24.1: katame dhammā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā
ds2.4.1:24.2: catusu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, catusu bhūmīsu vipāko, tīsu bhūmīsu kiriyāvyākataṃ, rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:24.3: ime dhammā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
ds2.4.1:25.2: cattāro diṭṭhigatasampayuttacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, etthuppannaṃ mohaṃ ṭhapetvā,
ds2.4.1:26.5: ime dhammā siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukā, siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
ds2.4.1:27.1: katame dhammā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā:
ds2.4.1:27.2: vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccasahagato moho, catusu bhūmisu kusalaṃ, catusu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:27.3: ime dhammā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
ds2.4.1:30.1: katame dhammā neva ācayagāmino na apacayagāmino:
ds2.4.1:30.2: catusu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:30.3: ime dhammā neva ācayagāmino na apacayagāmino.
ds2.4.1:31.2: cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, heṭṭhimāni ca tīṇi sāmaññaphalāni,
ds2.4.1:33.2: tīsu bhūmīsu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:34.2: kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, sabbo kāmāvacarassa vipāko, kāmāvacarakiriyāvyākataṃ, sabbaṃ ca rūpaṃ,
ds2.4.1:36.2: cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:37.2: sabbo kāmāvacarassa vipāko, kiriyāmanodhātu, kiriyāhetuka manoviññāṇadhātu somanassasahagatā,
ds2.4.1:39.2: cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni,
ds2.4.1:39.4: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro ñāṇavippayuttacittuppādā, kiriyato cattāro ñāṇavippayuttacittuppādā, sabbaṃ akusalaṃ,
ds2.4.1:39.5: ime dhammā siyā parittārammaṇā, siyā mahaggatārammaṇā, na appamāṇārammaṇā, siyā na vattabbā parittārammaṇātipi, mahaggatārammaṇātipi.
ds2.4.1:39.6: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro ñāṇasampayuttacittuppādā, kiriyato cattāro ñāṇasampayuttacittuppādā, rūpāvacaracatutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca kiriyato ca, kiriyāhetukamanoviññāṇadhātu upekkhāsahagatā,
ds2.4.1:39.7: ime dhammā siyā parittārammaṇā, siyā mahaggatārammaṇā, siyā appamāṇārammaṇā, siyā na vattabbā parittārammaṇātipi, mahaggatārammaṇātipi, appamāṇārammaṇātipi.
ds2.4.1:39.8: rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, catutthassa jhānassa vipāko, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ,
ds2.4.1:39.9: ime dhammā na vattabbā parittārammaṇātipi, mahaggatārammaṇātipi.
ds2.4.1:41.2: tīsu bhūmisu kusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, sabbaṃ ca rūpaṃ,
ds2.4.1:42.2: cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:43.3: ime dhammā siyā micchattaniyatā siyā aniyatā.
ds2.4.1:45.2: cattāro diṭṭhigatavippayuttā lobhasahagatacittuppādā, vicikicchāsahagato cittuppādo, uddhaccasahagato cittuppādo, tīsu bhūmisu kusalaṃ, catusu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, rūpaṃ ca, nibbānaṃ ca,
ds2.4.1:46.2: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro ñāṇasampayuttacittuppādā, kiriyato cattāro ñāṇasampayuttacittuppādā,
ds2.4.1:46.3: ime dhammā siyā maggārammaṇā, na maggahetukā,
ds2.4.1:46.4: siyā maggādhipatino, siyā na vattabbā maggārammaṇātipi maggādhipatinotipi.
ds2.4.1:46.6: siyā maggādhipatino, siyā na vattabbā maggādhipatinoti.
ds2.4.1:46.7: rūpāvacaracatutthajjhānaṃ kusalato ca kiriyato ca, kiriyāhetuka manoviññāṇadhātu upekkhāsahagatā,
ds2.4.1:46.11: kāmāvacarakusalato cattāro ñāṇavippayuttacittuppādā, sabbaṃ akusalaṃ, sabbo kāmāvacarassa vipāko, kiriyato cha cittuppādā, rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, catutthassa jhānassa vipāko, cattāro āruppā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni,
ds2.4.1:46.12: ime dhammā na vattabbā maggārammaṇātipi, maggahetukātipi, maggādhipatinotipi,
ds2.4.1:47.2: catusu bhūmīsu vipāko, yaṃ ca rūpaṃ kammassa katattā,
ds2.4.1:47.3: ime dhammā siyā uppannā, siyā uppādino,
ds2.4.1:47.5: catusu bhūmisu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, yaṃ ca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā,
ds2.4.1:47.6: ime dhammā siyā uppannā, siyā anuppannā, na vattabbā uppādinoti.
ds2.4.1:47.7: nibbānaṃ na vattabbaṃ uppannantipi anuppannantipi uppādinotipi. katame dhammā atītā:
ds2.4.1:48.1: nibbānaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbe dhammā siyā atītā, siyā anāgatā, siyā paccuppannā,
ds2.4.1:48.2: nibbānaṃ na vattabbaṃ atītantipi anāgatantipi paccuppannantipi.
ds2.4.1:51.4: kāmāvacarakusalassa vipākato dasa cittuppādā, akusalassa vipākato manoviññāṇadhātu upekkhāsahagatā, kiriyāhetukamanoviññāṇadhātu somanassasahagatā,
ds2.4.1:51.5: ime dhammā siyā atītārammaṇā siyā anāgatārammaṇā siyā paccuppannārammaṇā.
ds2.4.1:51.6: kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, kiriyato nava cittuppādā, rūpāvacaraṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca kiriyato ca,
ds2.4.1:51.7: ime dhammā siyā atītārammaṇā siyā anāgatārammaṇā siyā paccuppannārammaṇā;
ds2.4.1:51.8: siyā na vattabbā atītārammaṇātipi anāgatārammaṇātipi paccuppannārammaṇātipi.
ds2.4.1:51.9: rūpāvacaratikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, catutthassa jhānassa vipāko, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ, cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni,
ds2.4.1:51.10: ime dhammā na vattabbā atītārammaṇātipi anāgatārammaṇātipi paccuppannārammaṇātipi.
ds2.4.1:51.11: rūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca anārammaṇā. katame dhammā ajjhattā:
ds2.4.1:52.1: anindriyabaddharūpaṃ ca nibbānaṃ ca ṭhapetvā sabbe dhammā siyā ajjhattā, siyā bahiddhā, siyā ajjhattabahiddhā,
ds2.4.1:54.2: rūpāvacara tikacatukkajjhānā kusalato ca vipākato ca kiriyato ca, catutthassa jhānassa vipāko, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ, cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni.
ds2.4.1:54.4: rūpaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeva kāmāvacarā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā, rūpāvacaraṃ, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ kusalato ca kiriyato ca,
ds2.4.1:54.5: ime dhammā siyā ajjhattārammaṇā siyā bahiddhārammaṇā siyā ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇā.
ds2.4.1:54.6: ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ na vattabbaṃ ajjhattārammaṇantipi bahiddhārammaṇantipi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇantipi.
ds2.4.1:57.2: catusu bhūmisu kusalaṃ, akusalaṃ, catusu bhūmisu vipāko, tīsu bhūmisu kiriyāvyākataṃ, yaṃ ca rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ dhammāyatanapariyāpannaṃ, nibbānaṃ ca,
